Returns & Exchange

Returns

Due to hygiene and safety reasons, returns are only accepted for items that are damaged, defective, or incorrect upon delivery.

Returned items must be unused, in original packaging, and reported within 48 hours of delivery with clear photo proof.

Approved returns will be refunded to the original payment method within a reasonable processing time.

We reserve the right to reject return requests that do not meet the stated conditions.

Exchanges

We offer exchanges only for damaged, defective, or incorrect items received.

Exchange requests must be raised within 48 hours of delivery with supporting photo proof.

Once verified, the product will be replaced with the correct item subject to availability.

Exchanges are only applicable for unused products in original packaging.
